title: Edge stack owned by the CMS backend
description: papyrus-edge-anth-us (and the other sites' papyrus-edge-* stacks) were hand-run CloudFormation at cutover. The site template already supports distribution create/accept (distribution: { create, aliases, acm } or edgeDistributionArn). Bring each site's edge under its CMS backend so one app owns everything, without downtime or a domain re-association (Amplify domain throttle, see the papyrus-production notes). Change sets need Ryan's approval.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Design only, nothing executed: docs/hosting/edge-under-the-cms-backend.md and infra/edge/migration/ (stage 1 retain diff, resources-to-import JSON) in Papyrus PR #204. Plan A (recommended): CMS build runs a gated change-set deploy of the existing edge stack. Plan B: stage-by-stage resource import into the backend's CDK app; the nested-stack import question needs a throwaway spike. papyrus-edge-anth-us is IN_SYNC with infra/edge/anth-us-s3.yaml. Needs Ryan's approval before any change set.

right_now_summary: The team is planning to bring each site’s edge stack under its CMS backend without downtime.
